'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社)
Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[Japan]].
Similarly to the shrine of [[Ōtori Shrine|Ōtori Faith]], many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[Yamato Takeru]].
As a [[religious corporation]], there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.
